Role of the Local
Chief Executives
and Other Local
Government
The local chief executives as well as
government agencies shall provide necessary coordination?and support to
the Local Peace Fora to enhance the success of the peace efforts in the
area or community.

The National Peace Forum shall be funded
with an initial allocation of Twenty Million Pesos (P20,OOO,OOO)
President's Contingent Fund and existing and unexpended budget of the
GRP Panel for Talks with CPP /NPA/NDF to cover the cost of its activities
and that of the Local Peace Fora during the initial year of operation.
The National
Peace Forum shall also identify
budgetary requirements
for the succeeding years for inclusion
budget submission of the Office of the Presidential Adviser on the Peace
Process for Congressional appropriation.
All other Executive Orders and
Issuances inconsistent
with this Order or with any parts thereof are
hereby rescinded or modified accordingly.

Effectivity.
This Order shall take effect immediately,
DONE in the City of Manila, this 21st day of June, in the Year of
Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Nine.
